(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (first-component grid)
      (define visited (make-hash))
      (define found #f)
      (for* ([r (in-range (rows grid))] [c (in-range (cols grid))])
        (when (and (not found) (not (= (at grid r c) 0)) (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
          (define queue (list (list r c)))
          (define cells (list))
          (hash-set! visited (cons r c) #t)
          (define (bfs)
            (unless (empty? queue)
              (define p (first queue))
              (set! queue (rest queue))
              (set! cells (cons p cells))
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (define nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
                (define nc (+ (second p) (second d)))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                           (not (= (at grid nr nc) 0))
                           (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! visited (cons nr nc) #t)
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc))))))
              (bfs)))
          (bfs)
          (set! found (reverse cells))))
      found)
    (let* ((splits (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g)))) (range 0 (cols g))))
           (a (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (first splits) 1)))
           (b (subgrid g 0 (+ (first splits) 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- (second splits) 1)))
           (cpanel (subgrid g 0 (+ (second splits) 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (comp-a (first-component a))
           (comp-b (first-component b))
           (comp-c (first-component cpanel))
           (bb-a (bbox-of-cells comp-a))
           (bb-b (bbox-of-cells comp-b))
           (dr (- (first bb-b) (first bb-a)))
           (dc (- (second bb-b) (second bb-a))))
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows cpanel) (cols cpanel) 0)]) ([p (in-list comp-c)])
        (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr)) (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
          (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows cpanel) (cols cpanel))
              (set-cell out nr nc (at cpanel (first p) (second p)))
              out))))))
